scope: Recorded metric values, sealed content integrity, final references, denominators, aggregates and provider usage were checked independently. No official grader or solution file was loaded, and no results were supplied to a learning model.
private_evidence_scope: A structural inspection of the host evolution-result best reference exposed inline official test details to the reviewer; those details are not exported here, were not used for new tests or method changes, and were not fed to a learning role. This review does not assert that the reviewer inspected only public evidence.
limitations: One fresh evaluation per unique content version is a descriptive pilot measurement, not proof of causal improvement or statistical significance.
GT counts are official reporter groups, not counted Python assertions; surrogate results use their own suite and cannot be substituted.
Official reward, macro GT check fraction and task pass rate are separately recalculated.
DAPT selects the earlier reward-tied S1; higher independent GT fraction in S2 does not alter selection.
Final aliases the selected content evaluation; it is not another unrecorded measurement.
native_usage_scope: Only native provider identity.framework, operation_id/state and response.usage were projected. No native output/prompt/body fields were inspected; no Journal object was initialized.

audit_history.scope: initial reviewer read shared usage.jsonl only
audit_history.resolution: Native provider usage was added and both reviewers independently matched all 700 completed logical operations. This was incomplete audit coverage, not a demonstrated pipeline mismatch.

second_metrics_review.review_scope: Read-only hashes, counts and selections from final public export and sealed journals; no hidden grader bodies, reasoning, credentials or new model calls.
limits: PASS verifies agreement and integrity of exported measured results; it does not prove semantic correctness of generated tests or causal utility improvement.
Five selected tasks are a pilot;80unexecuted tasks are NOT_MEASURED.
NoSkill and each content have one fresh independent episode; no uncertainty estimate from repetitions is provided.
Independent content evaluation starts after learning completion and is not used in the recorded final selection.
Historical author best, actual terminal GT and final independent evaluation are checked separately.
Usage excludes diagnostic trials001/002; no monetary charge is inferred.
